criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines carry the mechanism (NSF AI Engine), the news trigger ($15M/$160M award), and signal the correction ('an option, not a check') within the ~210-char window, no snark.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Cooperative-agreement optionality genuinely drives an AK capital decision; consequence is concrete (critical-minerals sector, named allocators, ~2028 review). Both sides real.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: All four layers and every controlling actor match the dossier verbatim; no invented layers; chain is complete and readable.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: Primary chokepoint is crisp (layer two, NSF TIP, binary go/no-go, 'not a committee veto'), but the two-key framing adds NANA as a second actor, slightly diffusing the single-leverage claim.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a real, grounded position (two keys, AI only pays if both turn, 'capital and access are the open questions'), proportionate and mechanism-based, not a neutral explainer.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the next decision (NSF TIP year-two review ~2028), who is positioned (Alaska Silver, NANA JVs, vendors), and a this-week action. Concrete and datable.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: Every layer traces to a primary source in the dossier (NSF agency page, UAF GI release); chokepoint cites the NSF agency page. AI attribution correctly sourced to UAF GI per validation note.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, plain-language, business-literate; no banned phrases; reads like the analyst voice, not explainer-bot or influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Word count and char count in range, bullet block well-formed (4 single-clause items). Structural-read paragraph split into two after scoring for tighter mobile scan.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a real, debatable question tied directly to the chokepoint (which key is the real constraint), no CTA or rhetorical softener.

one_sentence_fix: Split the six-sentence structural-read paragraph into two tighter paragraphs (applied).
